errors.evidence: The date format on the x-axis is month/day/year (M/D/YYYY), as it shows consecutive days in March (3/1, 3/2, 3/3...). The description incorrectly states the format is day/month/year.
The text „Валеж (l/m²)“ is the title of the chart, not the label for the vertical axis. The vertical axis has no label.
The highest bar, on 3/7/2024, reaches a value significantly above 10.00, at approximately 10.8 l/m², which is much closer to 11.00.
